_comment: Release manifest for the OGN decoder binaries.
This file is the integrity anchor for every receiver. It is fetched from
raw.githubusercontent.com over TLS with a real certificate, which is what
makes the SHA256 below trustworthy. The binaries themselves come from
download.glidernet.org, which has no working HTTPS at all -- and answers
port 443 with cleartext, so a 'try TLS first' fallback would appear to
The md5 values are upstream's own, from download.glidernet.org/md5.txt.
They are checked, but only to catch a corrupt or truncated download: an
attacker able to alter the tarball over plain HTTP could alter that file
just as easily. The sha256 is the one that matters.

0.3.2.notes: Drops the libjpeg8 dependency the older guides all work around; links libpng16 instead.
